messages:
mira: Opening follow-up for the TLS handshake regression during the cross-region failover on 2026-03-18. Use this thread for owners, timelines, and recurrence checks. State owners + firm ETAs for remediation items.

raj: I'll own LB routing patch (SNI fallback reorder). Draft PR ready, needs CI + canary. ETA 2026-03-26. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/452

carmen: I'll own runbook + canary automation (add tls-handshake smoke step and rollback thresholds). Target 2026-03-29. Will open runbook PR and staging canary job.

sam: I'll handle DNS TTL and egress probe tuning + alerting for retry storms. Plan: reduce aggressive re-resolve TTL 60s->30s for affected pools, add alert for cross-region retries >5% over 5m. ETA 2026-03-24.

infra-bot: auto-tagged incident recurrence:tls-handshake and added to board "network-recurrences".

raj: Root cause appears to be SNI fallback ordering + conntrack latency on region failover. Reorder prevents sending handshake to fallback IP causing renegotiation. Patch is small config change:
```diff
-route_order: [primary, fallback, local]
+route_order: [primary, local, fallback]
```
Will add unit tests and a 1% prod canary.

mira: Add test matrix: unit + staging canary + 1% prod canary. Post canary metrics here (latency, handshake failures, retries).

carmen: Runbook items: force canary rollback, toggle fallback routing (k8s config), post-incident checklist for cross-region failover. Adding smoke check hitting /health?tls=1 and verifying TLS <200ms. PR inbound.

sam: DNS steps: 1) change LB pool TTL to 30s in staging; 2) run 24h canary; 3) schedule prod change in maintenance window if stable. Grafana alert: sum(rate(retry_count[5m])) / sum(rate(request_count[5m])) > 0.05 for >5m.

mira: We had 3 recurrences this quarter (INF-1209, INF-1334, INF-1482). Tag PRs with recurrence:tls-handshake. Ops: please note whether autoscaling bursts correlate.

raj: Added recurrence tag. Also creating a benchmark script to replay failover and measure handshake error ratio.

carmen: PR opened for runbook + canary job: https://github.com/redwood/ops-docs/pull/459 includes rollback thresholds and alert links.

sam: DNS change PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/460. Dashboard link included.

mira: Action summary (confirm dates): A1 LB routing patch (raj) ETA 2026-03-26, unit tests + 1% prod canary. A2 Runbook + canary automation (carmen) ETA 2026-03-29, smoke TLS check + rollback. A3 DNS TTL + alert tuning (sam) ETA 2026-03-24, 24h staging canary then prod window. A4 Recurrence tracking + retro note (mira) ETA 2026-03-31, update board and link postmortem (INF-1789).

raj: Confirmed, will post canary metrics to #incidents.

carmen: Confirmed, will request SRE + ProdEng review.

sam: Confirmed, will schedule maintenance after canary.

mira: Sync Wed 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT). Post updates by EOD Tue 2026-03-23 or call out ETA changes ASAP. :eyes:

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up-sync on 1937830000 posted to #incidents.

mira: Thanks, adding items to postmortem doc and creating JIRA INF-1789 for tracking.
